# Dependencies

## Fabric

* [Fabric API (Required)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
* [Fabric Language Kotlin (Required)](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)

## Quilt

* [QSL (Required)](https://modrinth.com/mod/qsl)
* [QKL (Required)](https://modrinth.com/mod/qkl)

# Description

This mod adds utility and technology features to make Minecraft life easier than vanilla. It also helps simplify some recipes and resource gathering.

## Repair Station

A utility block that repairs your tools. It requires Glow Dust and Glow Blocks as fuel to charge and operate.

## Totem of Cycle

A special totem that changes time between day and night when right-clicked. Has a 30-second cooldown.

## Drills

Drills can mine in a 3×3×1 area.

* When mining normal blocks, ores will not be automatically mined.
* When mining ores, connected ore veins will break instantly.
